AmortisedRate.name: Amortised Rate
AmortisedRate.definition: Rate that will be applicable as of the next factor date and defines the outstanding principal of the factored security.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Amount of cash, expressed as a percentage, disbursed per financial instrument.

CashIndemnityRate.name: Cash Indemnity Rate
CashIndemnityRate.definition: Ratio of compensation for damage/loss versus value of insured entity

DividendReinvestmentIndicator.name: Dividend Reinvestment Indicator
DividendReinvestmentIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a cash dividend can be rolled over into shares of the issuing company.

InterestAmount.name: Interest Amount
InterestAmount.definition: Amount of interest paid to the principal amount of the financial instrument for a specific period of time.

InterestRate.name: Interest Rate
InterestRate.definition: Ratio of the amount of interest paid to the principal amount of the financial instrument for a specific period of time.

LoyaltyPremiumIndicator.name: Loyalty Premium Indicator
LoyaltyPremiumIndicator.definition: Indicates whether dividends, in addition to regular dividends, are payable to loyal (time, size, amount) investors.

PaymentType.name: Payment Type
PaymentType.definition: Provides information about the whether the payment will be before or after tax.

SelectionDate.name: Selection Date
SelectionDate.definition: Date/time at which securities are selected for redemption prior to maturity.

CashDistributionRate.name: Cash Distribution Rate
CashDistributionRate.definition: Amount, expressed as a percentage, of cash disbursed per financial instrument.

CashDistributionAmount.name: Cash Distribution Amount
CashDistributionAmount.definition: Amount of cash disbursed per financial instrument.

DistributionCurrencyExchangeInformation.name: Distribution Currency Exchange Information
DistributionCurrencyExchangeInformation.definition: Detailed information about the currency exchange in a distribution event.

SecuritiesAndCashDistribution.name: Securities And Cash Distribution
SecuritiesAndCashDistribution.definition: Distribution for which the cash distribution elements are provided.
